items.name: Matcher
items.summary: `Matcher` defines whether a tree-sitter node matches certain pattern, and update the matched meta-variable values in `MetaVarEnv`. N.B. At least one positive term is required for matching

methods.summary: Returns the node why the input is matched or None if not matched. The return value is usually input node itself, but it can be different node. For example `Has` matcher can return the child or descendant node.

methods.name: potential_kinds
methods.summary: Returns a bitset for all possible target node kind ids. Returns None if the matcher needs to try against all node kind.

items.name: MatcherExt
items.summary: MatcherExt provides additional utility methods for `Matcher`. It is implemented for all types that implement `Matcher`. N.B. This trait is not intended to be implemented by users.
